title: Post-TIPS Prediction via Multimodal Interaction: A Multi-Center Dataset and Framework for Survival, Complication, and Portal Pressure Assessment
reasoning: The paper focuses on medical prognosis for patients undergoing the Transjugular intrahepatic portosystemic shunt (TIPS) procedure. It introduces a new dataset and a multimodal framework for survival and complication prediction. It does not evaluate religion, morals, or ethics beyond standard mentions of data de-identification and ethics committee approval for medical research.
